# Litmatch System Atlas

> Static-analysis context pack of the Litmatch social voice app (NestJS core-api, signaling-gateway, LiveKit media-server, Next.js web, Vite admin): database schema, REST API, async flows, cache/state, config, frontend routes to API map, 22 feature slices, project roadmap. Many small markdown/JSON files with stable ids. Code wins over docs; nothing is hidden.

## Start here

- [roadmap.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/roadmap.md): reading roadmap, project roadmap, open work
- [pack/README.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/README.md): id scheme and task routing
- [pack/lookup/index.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/lookup/index.md): one-line lookups: endpoint, table, env var, error code, event, issue, flow, entrypoint to flow
- [search-index.json](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/search-index.json): every entity and fine-grained id with url (machine search)
- [sitemap.xml](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/sitemap.xml): all URLs
- [index.json](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/index.json): manifest of documents with related ids
- [llms-full.txt](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/llms-full.txt): indexes, roadmap and lookups concatenated

## Indexes

- [pack/modules/index.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/modules/index.md): 25 modules, one datasheet each
- [pack/slices/index.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/slices/index.md): FEATURE SLICES: follow one feature from screen to database (start here for "follow feature X")
- [pack/fe/index.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/fe/index.md): frontend routes, features, state, errors, i18n, UI action map
- [pack/flows/index.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/flows/index.md): 72 cross-service backend flows
- [pack/api/index.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/api/index.md): REST API contract per module
- [pack/db/index.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/db/index.md): tables per module
- [pack/events/index.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/events/index.md): realtime events, jobs, outbox, metrics
- [pack/errors/index.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/errors/index.md): error codes per group
- [pack/config/index.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/config/index.md): environment variables by prefix
- [pack/service-map/index.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/service-map/index.md): why services talk to each other, techniques, Q&A, findings
- [pack/system/index.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/system/index.md): async, state, domain rules, CI/CD sections written from code
- [pack/issues/index.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/issues/index.md): problems met while building (full ledger)
- [pack/project/roadmap-source.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/project/roadmap-source.md): docs/07-roadmap.md of the repo
- [pack/project/capacity-plan.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/project/capacity-plan.md): capacity and scaling plan 2026-10-08
- [pack/project/feature-registry.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/project/feature-registry.md): feature registry and deferred decisions
- [pack/project/docs-map.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/project/docs-map.md): every doc of the repo with title and last change
- [pack/recipes.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/recipes.md): what past commits of each kind touched
- [pack/reconciliation.md](https://ducmanh001.github.io/litmatch-atlas-demo/pack/reconciliation.md): where the atlas and the service map disagree
